digest.headline: Platform and AI tooling, week 40
digest.intro: Three releases worth a look this week.

items.title: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling
items.summary: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling, which keeps slow and failed requests and drops the rest. Rules are written in a small policy file.
items.whyItMatters: Tail sampling keeps slow and failed requests and drops the rest.

items.title: Jorrick Models publishes a small code model
items.summary: Jorrick Models publishes a small code model with open weights. The weights ship under a permissive licence.
items.whyItMatters: The weights ship under a permissive licence.

items.title: Dunmore Streams raises the partition limit
items.summary: Dunmore Streams raises the limit to 128 partitions per topic. Existing topics can grow in place.
items.whyItMatters: Topics can grow without a rebuild.

sources.title: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling
sources.summary: Galewood Traces adds tail sampling, which keeps slow and failed requests and drops the rest. Rules are written in a small policy file. Sampling decisions are written to an audit stream for later review.

sources.title: Jorrick Models publishes a small code model
sources.summary: Jorrick Models publishes a small code model with open weights. The weights ship under a permissive licence. A fill-in-the-middle mode is included for editor completion.

sources.title: Dunmore Streams raises the partition limit
sources.summary: Dunmore Streams raises the limit to 120 partitions per topic. Existing topics can grow in place. Consumers need no change.
